name: IC Sensor — I2C — SOT-23
description: SMD IC sensor cluster in SOT-23 packaging with an I2C interface, featuring magnetic and temperature sensors such as TLV493D, TMP100, and TMP101.
selection_hints: Require an SMD IC sensor with an I2C communication interface.
Need a SOT-23 or SOT-23-6 package footprint.
Choosing between magnetic (TLV493D) or temperature (TMP100, TMP101) sensing.
avoid_when: A non-I2C bus or interface is required.
Package footprints other than SOT-23 or SOT-23-6 are needed.
Non-SMD or through-hole mounting is required.
